overview: A personal finance tracker for monthly budgets with expense logging, category spending limits, analytics charts, recurring expense templates, receipt photo attachments, and CSV export — all in Namibian dollars (N$).
features: Monthly budget categories with spending limits
Expense logging with optional receipt photo attachments
Spending trend charts (12-month line chart and category bar chart)
Recurring expense templates that auto-add each month
CSV export of monthly budget summary and expenses
Color-coded progress bars for budget status
Month switching to review past spending
